answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 28642 Country: India Title: The sleeping of one who is praying, even though it may be whilst performing ruku or sujud, provided he maintains his posture according to the sunna." This does not break wudu. Is is true? If yes, can you tell me the dalail ? Question: As Salam Aleykum wa rahmatullah wa barakatahu, Wudu: "the sleeping of one who is praying, even though it may be whilst performing ruku or sujud, provided he maintains his posture according to the sunna." This does not break wudu. Is is true? If yes, can you Insha'Allah tell me the dalail Insha'Allah. WasSalam. Answer ID: 28642 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 133/103/H=1432) In the question mentioned above, the wudhu did not break due to sleeping. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
